sermons.title: The Power of the Word in Your Mouth
summary: Your words carry creative power when aligned with God's Word.
Faith is released through confession, not just belief.
Frame your world daily by declaring what God has said.

sermons.title: Walking in the God-Kind of Love
summary: The love of God has been poured into your heart by the Holy Spirit.
Love is not a feeling but a decision that seeks the other's good.
The Christian life fails without love as its foundation.
